sentences.text: Except an oral assertion that the cheques issued by the accused were dishonored, the prosecution has not placed cogent evidence before the court to substantiate that aspect.
The PW.7 deposed regarding drawing of Ex.P.2 spot mahazar.
His further chief examination was deferred as the Court time was over.
Thereafter, the PW.7 did not appear before the Court.
Inspite of issuance of repeated non bailable warrants, proclamations, the PW.7 being the IO did not care to tender himself for further chief examination and cross examination.

By noting the age of the case and absence of PW.7,
this court dropped him from examination.
32. Mere production of cheques before the court itself is not a proof of dishonor of cheques.

Because,
the prosecution has not produced any documents before the court to show that Ex.P.7 to 20 cheques were presented for encashment and they were dishonored for insufficient funds or some other reasons.
In the absence of endorsements issued by the bank, it cannot be accepted that the cheques produced in this case are dishonored.
33. The oral evidence of PW.1, 4, 5 and 6 appears to be baseless.
Therefore, there is no convincing evidence on record to connect the accused with the alleged crime.

In such circumstances, the prosecution has failed to prove that, the accused cheated and deceived PW.1 to deliver his car bearing No.KA.41.A.9278 by issuing cheques towards the purchase of the same on 18.01.2015 at his residence, which is situated at Ganesh layout, Vidyaranyapura, which was dishonored for not keeping sufficient amount in his account and on 06.02.2016 when PW.1 and 6 questioned his acts by making phone call, he abused them in a filthy language and threatened them with dire consequences..
Accordingly, I answer point No.1 to 3 in Negative.

Point No.4: For the aforesaid reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
By exercising the powers conferred U/Sec.248[1] of Cr.P.C., the accused is acquitted from the charges of 420, 504, 506 of IPC.
The bail bonds executed by the accused stands cancelled.
The bonds executed by the accused U/Sec.437[A] of Cr.P.C., will be in force till the completion of appeal period.
